# infisical_dynamic_secret_openrouter (Resource)

Create and manage OpenRouter Dynamic Secret

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_dynamic_secret_openrouter" "openrouter" {
  name             = "openrouter-dynamic-secret-example"
  project_slug     = "your-project-slug"
  environment_slug = "dev"
  path             = "/"
  default_ttl      = "1h"
  max_ttl          = "24h"

  configuration = {
    management_key        = "<your-openrouter-management-key>"
    workspace_id          = "<your-openrouter-workspace-id>" # Optional, defaults to the management key's default workspace
    limit                 = "2.5"                            # Optional, spending limit in USD per created API key
    limit_reset           = "monthly"                        # Optional, one of daily, weekly or monthly
    include_byok_in_limit = false
  }

  username_template = "{{randomUsername}}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `configuration` (Attributes) The configuration of the dynamic secret (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration))
- `default_ttl` (String) The default TTL that will be applied for all the leases.
- `environment_slug` (String) The slug of the environment to create the dynamic secret in.
- `name` (String) The name of the dynamic secret.
- `path` (String) The path to create the dynamic secret in.
- `project_slug` (String) The slug of the project to create dynamic secret in.

### Optional

- `max_ttl` (String) The maximum limit a TTL can be leased or renewed for.
- `metadata` (Attributes Set) The metadata associated with this dynamic secret (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `username_template` (String) The username template of the dynamic secret

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the dynamic secret.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration`

Optional:

- `include_byok_in_limit` (Boolean) Whether bring-your-own-key usage counts toward the spending limit. Defaults to false.
- `limit` (String) The spending limit in USD applied to each created API key, as a decimal string such as "2.5". Leave unset for no limit.
- `limit_reset` (String) How often the spending limit resets. Supported values are daily, weekly and monthly. Leave unset for a limit that never resets.
- `management_key` (String, Sensitive) The OpenRouter management API key used to create and delete the API keys issued for each lease. This value is stored in the Terraform state; use management_key_wo to keep it out of state. Exactly one of management_key or management_key_wo must be set. Infisical never returns this value, so changes made outside of Terraform are not detected. The key can't be changed while the dynamic secret has active leases, and a new key must belong to the same OpenRouter organization. Self-hosted instances need an Infisical release newer than v0.167.10.
- `management_key_wo` (String, Sensitive) The OpenRouter management API key (write-only). This value is never stored in the Terraform state and can accept ephemeral values. Because it is not stored, changes to it are not detected; increment management_key_wo_version to push a new value. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `management_key_wo_version` (Number) The version of the management_key_wo value. Increment this to trigger an update of the management key.
- `workspace_id` (String) The ID of the OpenRouter workspace to create keys in. Defaults to the management key's default workspace.
